name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.2 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 8 visits over 65 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 44 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2025-05-30, at wavelengths from 1.10 to 4.57 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
